name: The Chiba Bank, Ltd.
summary: The Chiba Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Japan and internationally. It offers time, installment time, and foreign currency deposits; loan products, such as home, card, car, education, home renovation, personal, and other loans; credit and debit cards; and asset management products, including investment trusts, NISA, Walthnavi, public debt, defined contribution pension plan, and other asset management products.
